caption:
Google is taking its AI search ads worldwide because regular ad growth is slowing down. Parent company Alphabet just pulled in $127.6 billion in quarterly revenue, but the search business is cooling off. So now your robotic search answers come with sponsored shopping links. 

Are you clicking on these AI ads or just ignoring them? 🤖

@google

Source: TechCrunch

#GoogleAI #SearchAds #DigitalMarketing #TechNews #MarketingStrategy

post.news: Google is rolling out ads in AI Search globally as core ad growth slows down, alongside $127.6 billion in quarterly revenue.
post.take: Google found a way to slow down search growth and immediately answer it with more ads.
post.insight: When core search growth slows down, tech giants turn their shiny new AI features into billboards fast.
